SELECT p.*, o.name AS organization_name FROM project p INNER JOIN organization o ON o.id = p.organization_id WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role_relation urr INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.id = urr.role_id WHERE urr.source_id = p.id AND urr.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.type = 'PROJECT' AND ur.enabled = b'1' )
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR p.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR CAST(p.num AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.enable = #{request.enable}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.*, o.name AS organization_name FROM project p INNER JOIN organization o ON o.id = p.organization_id WHERE p.deleted = b'0' AND p.enable = b'1'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role_relation urr INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.id = urr.role_id INNER JOIN user_role_permission urp ON urp.role_id = ur.id WHERE urr.source_id = p.id AND urr.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.type = 'PROJECT' AND ur.enabled = b'1' AND urp.permission_id = #{permissionId} )
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR p.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR CAST(p.num AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT count(1) > 0 FROM user_role_relation urr INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.id = urr.role_id INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = urr.source_id WHERE urr.source_id = #{projectId} AND urr.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.type = 'PROJECT' AND ur.enabled = b'1' AND p.deleted = b'0' AND p.enable = b'1'
SELECT count(1) > 0 FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted = b'0' AND enable = b'1'

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM user_role u JOIN user_role_relation urr ON u.id = urr.role_id JOIN project p ON p.id = urr.source_id JOIN user on urr.user_id = user.id where urr.user_id = #{userId} and u.type = 'PROJECT' AND p.organization_id = #{organizationId} and p.enable = 1 and user.deleted = 0 order by CONVERT( p.name USING GBK) ASC
select module_setting from project where id = #{projectId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM user_role u JOIN user_role_relation urr ON u.id = urr.role_id JOIN project p ON p.id = urr.source_id JOIN user on urr.user_id = user.id where urr.user_id = #{userId} and u.type = 'PROJECT' and p.enable = 1 and user.deleted = 0

select id, name, organization_id from project where organization_id = #{organizationId}
order by create_time desc limit 1000

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, p.organization_id, p.create_time FROM user_role u JOIN user_role_relation urr ON u.id = urr.role_id JOIN project p ON p.id = urr.source_id JOIN user on urr.user_id = user.id where urr.user_id = #{userId} and u.type = 'PROJECT' and p.enable = 1 and user.deleted = 0 and p.organization_id = #{organizationId} order by p.create_time desc limit 1000

select p.* from project_test_resource_pool p left join test_resource_pool t on t.id = p.test_resource_pool_id where p.project_id = #{projectId} and t.enable = 1 and t.deleted = 0
select * from project where enable = 1 and organization_id = #{organizationId} order by CONVERT( name USING GBK) ASC
select t.* from project_test_resource_pool p left join test_resource_pool t on t.id = p.test_resource_pool_id where p.project_id = #{projectId} and t.enable = 1 and t.deleted = 0
select * from project where enable = 1 and organization_id = #{organizationId} AND module_setting like concat('%', #{module},'%') order by CONVERT( name USING GBK) ASC
